title: Local open cohomology of lower truncations stabilizes in two adjacent degrees
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space and $E\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_X))$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $b:\mathbf Z\to\mathbf Z$ and $B$ be any family of open subsets of $X$. Suppose $H^p(U,H^{r-p}(E))=0$ for every $r\in\mathbf Z$, $p\in\mathbf N$, $U\in B$ with $p>b(r)$ [def-sc-open-module-cohomology]. For every $m\in\mathbf Z$, there exists $N\in\mathbf N$ with $-N\le m$ such that for every $U\in B$ and $n\ge N$, the canonical transition $\tau_{\ge -n-1}E\to\tau_{\ge -n}E$ [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category] induces isomorphisms on $H^{m-1}(R\Gamma(U,-))$ and $H^m(R\Gamma(U,-))$ [def-pc-open-module-derived-sections].

source.place: Tag 0D62, label lemma-is-limit-per-point, final truncation-triangle paragraph

proof.text: Choose N = max(-m, b(m-1)-m, b(m)-m-1, b(m+1)-m-2).toNat + 1. For n >= N and q in {m-1,m,m+1}, put p=(q+n+1).toNat. Integer arithmetic gives p=q+n+1>=0, p>b(q), and q-p=-n-1. The hypothesis makes H^p(U,H^(-n-1)(E)) zero, uniformly in U in B.

Apply the successive lower-truncation distinguished triangle at n+1. Apply RΓ(U,-), which carries distinguished triangles to distinguished triangles and commutes with shifts. Its first object is RΓ(U,H^(-n-1)(E)[n+1]).

The cohomology shift isomorphism identifies H^q of that object with H^(q+n+1)(RΓ(U,H^(-n-1)(E)[0])). The single-object comparison for bounded-below right derived functors, transported along the proved unbounded/bounded-below compatibility, identifies this with the classical open module cohomology in degree p. Transport the zero objects from the first step across these explicit isomorphisms.

The first object of the mapped triangle has zero cohomology in degrees m-1, m and m+1. Apply the long exact cohomology sequence twice: the middle homology map is monic and epic in degrees m-1 and m, hence is an isomorphism. Rewrite -(n+1)+1=-n to identify the middle arrow with the stated transition.

theorem pointwise_truncation_open_stabilization (X : RingedSpace.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{v} AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    (E : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)))
    (b : ℤ → ℤ) (B : Set (Opens X))
    (hvan : ∀ (m : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (U : Opens X), U ∈ B → b m < (p : ℤ) →
      IsZero ((openModuleCohomology X p U).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X))
          (m - (p : ℤ))).obj E)))
    (m : ℤ) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, -(N : ℤ) ≤ m ∧ ∀ (U : Opens X), U ∈ B → ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n →
      IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (m - 1)).map
        ((openModuleDerivedSections X U).map
          ((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.natTransTruncGEOfLE
            (-((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (-(n : ℤ)) (by omega)).app E))) ∧
      IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} m).map
        ((openModuleDerivedSections X U).map
          ((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.natTransTruncGEOfLE
            (-((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (-(n : ℤ)) (by omega)).app E)))
